settings.intro_highlight: Precision-engineered for advanced clinical workflows, the Ultra-Comfort treatment chair bridges the gap between ergonomic practitioner support and exceptional client relaxation, backed by decades of North American manufacturing expertise.
settings.custom_description:
Ultra-Comfort is purpose-built for licensed skincare specialists, including Estheticians, Clinical Spa Therapists, and Cosmetic Injectors. Its 15-degree tilt mechanism targets lower-back tension and postural strain during extended treatment sessions, enabling sharper focus on service consistency and client comfort. Whether you are performing deep-pore cleansing, microdermabrasion, or post-procedure recovery, this professional station adjusts to your modality-specific positioning with manually adjustable backrest components and smooth elevation controls.

The Ultra-Comfort chair offers precise positioning and optimal ergonomics for facials and hair removal. Featuring an adjustable headrest and manually adjustable backrest and leg rest, it incorporates a 15° tilt to improve comfort and access to the face and neck areas. Its ultra-white, ultra-resistant leatherette ensures durability, while its adjustable height from 20.5“ to 36.5” and widths of 24“ or 26” suit any space. Removable ergonomic armrests and casters are optional. Available in a range of colors
settings.subtitle: Engineering for Precision and Longevity
settings.secondary_description: Long-term durability is central to the Equipro approach. To preserve the mechanical integrity and surface quality of Ultra-Comfort, routine cleaning with non-abrasive disinfectants formulated for clinical environments is recommended weekly. The ultra-resistant leatherette upholstery features high tear and stain resistance, ensuring pristine condition across intensive daily salon cycles. Consistent care prevents premature wear, maintaining both aesthetic appeal and hygienic compliance.

settings.question: Clinical Aesthetics & Specialized Facials:
settings.answer: For the licensed esthetician performing intensive deep-pore cleansing or multi-step anti-aging protocols, maintaining a neutral posture is vital during long shifts. The Ultra-Comfort chair integrates a 15-degree tilt system that brings the facial plane closer to the practitioner, eliminating lower-back strain and visual fatigue. By optimizing the working angle, technicians can execute delicate extractions and product applications with absolute precision, enhancing both treatment efficacy and client comfort.

settings.question: Advanced Clinical Spa Treatments:
settings.answer: Clinical spa therapists and cosmetic injectors require absolute stability and rapid adjustability when transitioning between client consultation and clinical execution. The wide height adjustment range—spanning from 20.5 to 36.5 inches—allows practitioners to seamlessly shift from seated consultations to standing procedures. This adaptability reduces shoulder fatigue and supports a streamlined workflow during back-to-back clinical appointments, ensuring consistent ergonomic health for the operator.

settings.question: Hair Removal & Full-Body Services:
settings.answer: Executing hair removal or multi-zone body treatments demands reliable positioning support that accommodates various client statures without sacrificing stability. The manually adjustable backrest and leg rest components lock securely into place, providing dependable support throughout high-volume clinic days. The ultra-resistant leatherette surface withstands frequent sanitation protocols, delivering a hygienic, professional-grade workstation built for enduring performance.
